headline: Smaller language models outperform GPT on coding security tasks
body: Researchers demonstrated that smaller language models combined with integrity risk management can exceed GPT-5.5-xhigh performance on coding agent security, while Simular's Sai model achieves comparable results to top-tier systems at two-thirds the cost. This matters for healthcare AI because many clinical coding and documentation workflows rely on LLM agents, where cost efficiency and security are non-negotiable. Healthcare organizations evaluating AI infrastructure can now consider smaller, specialized models for specific EHR and clinical coding tasks without sacrificing capability. The shift toward smaller, purpose-built models has direct implications for vendor selection and total cost of ownership in healthcare implementations.
